REGISTRY
4th October 5
Sir,
In connection with the report that the Germans have established an agency for the purchase of arms, that the head of the organisation or one of its prominent members is also head of the Police of the German Concession at Shanghai, and that the agency is situated in rooms No.8 & 10 on the first floor of No 98 Szechuan Road, I beg to state that, the result of enquiries show, there does not appear to be any truth in the report that the organisation has its headquarters in rooms No 8 and 10 on the first floor of 98 Szechuan Road. No.8 is occupied by an American named L.Everret who is selling canned goods and No.10 by a German named Nielsen who is in the employ of Garrels Bremer & Co 27 Kiangse Road and who may deal in arms although not necessarily at Room No.10.
C.Grapow is living at the boarding house of Mrs.A.Lukres No 48 & 48A Bubbling Well Road. He visits Neumann's restaurant every evening, stays there till closing time and states that he is down here for a holiday.
The Russians have not bought and do not intend buying a single revolver and so the recently made statement of E.W. Rickhoff the German who lives at No 33 Kiangsi Road about forming a combine to buy these weapons, lest they should fall into Russian hands, cannot be true.
Rickhoff has several times approached the Military Governor in an endeavour to sell to him some 8000 rifles with ammunition which he said could be brought to Shanghai if the Governor would pay the price asked.
H.Newman a British subject now gone home and a British jew named E.H.Shubbeth who resides at No.1 Kungping Road also spoke as if they had a commission to sell these same rifles.
The names of Denigri and Farlani, Italians, J.Mencarini, Spaniard, R.F.Herzog, Austrian, and St. Pierre Rattinger were also mentioned in connection with this affair.
Admiral Tsang was approached many times and he pretended to be interested in order to ascertain where the rifles really were but he never succeeded. He was always told that the whereabouts of the weapons was unknown but that they could be delivered in Shanghai in two days. He gave it up in the end as he began suspect that the arm sellers were merely trying to get money out of him and that they had no other object in view.

10月4日 5
先生，
关于有报告称德国人已设立一个军火采购代理机构，该组织负责人或其重要成员之一是上海德租界警察局长，且该机构位于四川路98号一楼8号和10号房间，谨此陈述，经查询结果显示，所谓该组织总部设在四川路98号一楼8号和10号房间的说法似乎并无事实依据。8号房间由一名名叫 L.Everret 的美国人占用，他正在销售罐头食品；10号房间由一名名叫 Nielsen 的德国人占用，他受雇于江西路27号的 Garrels Bremer & Co 公司，此人可能从事军火交易，但不一定是在10号房间进行。
C.Grapow 居住在静安寺路48及48A号 A.Lukres 太太的寄宿公寓。他每晚都去 Neumann 餐厅，一直待到打烊，并声称他是来此地度假的。
俄国人并未购买，也不打算购买任何左轮手枪，因此，居住在江西路33号的德国人 E.W. Rickhoff 最近关于组建联合体购买这些武器以防落入俄国人手中的说法不可能是真的。
Rickhoff 曾多次接触督军，试图向他出售约8000支步枪及弹药，并称如果督军支付要价，这些武器可以运至上海。
已回国的英国臣民 H.Newman 和居住在公平路1号的英籍犹太人 E.H.Shubbeth 也表现得好像他们受委托出售同样的步枪。
在此事中还提到了意大利人 Denigri 和 Farlani、西班牙人 J.Mencarini、奥地利人 R.F.Herzog 以及 St. Pierre Rattinger 的名字。
曾多次接触臧总督，他假装感兴趣以查明步枪究竟在何处，但从未成功。他总是被告知武器下落不明，但可以在两天内运抵上海。他最终放弃了，因为他开始怀疑军火商只是想从他那里骗钱，而没有其他目的。

As the result of enquiries made he ascertained
that , a former Governor of Szechuan had, during the
regime of Chen Chi May [陈其美] in Shanghai placed an
order for a somewhat similar number of rifles in
Germany, that these rifles had actually been shipped
from Germany but that there was no record to show
that they ever arrived in China and he imagined that
they might have been landed somewhere on the coast or
on islands near the entrance to the Yangtse although
it was hardly likely.
It was also suggested that the arms might have been
carried on to Japan and that they were stored at Nagasaki.
Anyhow nothing was discovered and these arms since
about the middle of the summer have ceased to be much
talked about. Recently however it appears that
efforts have been made by certain foreign firms whose
names I do not know to sell a similar quantity of
rifles in Peking, the offers there being made under
similar conditions to those made to the Admiral.
Peking referred the matter to Shanghai and were
advised to have nothing to do with the business.
Now it looks as if the members of the arms gang were
at present endeavouring to sell the arms to the Russians
and threatening that if they do not buy they will sell
to the Germans who are anxious to get them. They are
evidently quite prepared to accommodate the enemies of
their country and furnish them with weapons to shoot
their own brethren if there is to be any money to be
made out of it.
Enquiries are being made as to whether there are
any arms stored in Manila and we shall know in about a
fortnight from now. It is quite possible that a
consignment from Europe may have gone there for storage.
It is a convenient place.
A German mail steamer Bayern which was bound for
China when the war broke out sought shelter at Naples
and it is reported that when some months later Italy
declared war with Austria the vessel was searched and
a great quantity of rifles with ammunition consigned
to the Chinese Government was found on board and
confiscated.

经查询，他查明
一位前四川省督在陈其美在上海执政期间，
曾在德国订购了数量大致相同的步枪，
这些步枪确实已从德国装运，但没有记录显示
它们曾抵达中国，他推测它们可能在沿海某处
或长江口附近的岛屿上岸，尽管这种可能性
微乎其微。
也有人提出，这批军火可能被运往日本，
并储存在长崎。
总之，没有任何发现，自夏季中旬以来，
关于这批军火的谈论已大大减少。然而最近，
似乎有一些我不知其名的外国商行努力在北京
出售数量相似的步枪，那里的报价条件与向海军上将
提出的条件相似。
北京方面将此事项转介至上海，并被告知
不要参与此事。
现在看来，这个军火团伙的成员目前正努力
将这批军火卖给俄国人，并威胁说如果俄国人
不买，他们就卖给急于得到这批武器的德国人。
显然，只要能从中获利，他们完全准备迎合
本国的敌人，并向他们提供武器来射杀自己的同胞。
目前正在查询马尼拉是否储存有任何军火，
我们大约在两周后便会知晓。很有可能是来自
欧洲的一批货物已运往那里储存。
那是一个便利的地方。
德国邮船“巴伐利亚”号（Bayern）在战争爆发时
正驶往中国，在那不勒斯寻求庇护，据报道，
几个月后意大利对奥地利宣战时，对该船进行了
搜查，发现船上有一大批运往中国政府的步枪
及弹药，并予以没收。

arms in order to prevent them from falling intp Russian hands but
I doubt very much whether the motives of the combine are of such
a patriotic nature as Eickhoff would try to make out. The fact
that he was negotiating for the sale of arms to unauthorized
Chinese shows that the methods of the combine are not such as
would be recommended among those who have any regard for the wel-
fare of this Country or the International Settlement. Again,
I am informed that the Russians are not at all anxious to buy
pistols at present nor would obsolete rifles be any use to them.

doubt many small lots dribble in with the baggage of Foreign

4th October 1915

Sir,
In connection with the report that the Germans have established an agency for the purchase of arms, that the head of the organisation or one of its prominent members is G.Grapow head of the Police of the German Concession at Hankow, and that the agency is situated in rooms No.8 & 10 on the first floor of No 96 Szechuen Road, I beg to state that, the result of enquiries show, there does not appear to be any truth in the report that the organisation has its headquarters in rooms No 8 and 10 on the first floor of 96 Szechuen Road. No.8 is occupied by an American named L.Everret who is selling canned goods and No.10 by a German named Nielsen who is in the employ of Garrels Bremer & Co 27 Kiangse Road and who may deal in arms although not necessarily at Room No.10.
G.Grapow is living at the boarding house of Mrs.A Lührss No 48 & 48A Bubbling Well Road. He visits Neumann's restaurant every evening, stays there till closing time and states that he is down here for a holiday.
The Russians have not bought and do not intend buying a single revolver and so the recently made statement of E.W. Eickhoff the German who lives at No 35 Kiangsi Road about forming a combine to buy these weapons, lest they should fall into Russian hands, cannot be true.
Eickhoff has several times approached the Military Governor in an endeavour to sell to him some 8000 rifles with ammunition which he said could be brought to Shanghai if the Governor would pay the price asked.
M.Newman a British subject now gone home and a British jew named E.H.Shibbeth who resides at No.1 Kungping Road also spoke as if they had a commission to sell these same rifles.
The names of Denigri and Pariani, Italians, J.Mencarini, Spaniard, R.J.Herzog, Austrian, and St. Piero Ruginger were also mentioned in connection with this affair.
Admiral Tseng was approached many times and he pretended to be interested in order to ascertain where the rifles really were but he never succeeded. He was always told that the whereabouts of the weapons was unknown but that they could be delivered in Shanghai in two days. He gave it up in the end as he began suspect that the arm sellers were merely trying to get money out of him and that they had no other object in view.

G.格拉波居住在静安寺路48号及48A号 A.吕尔斯（A Lührss）夫人的寄宿公寓。他每晚都去诺伊曼（Neumann）餐厅，一直待到打烊，并声称他是来此地度假的。
俄国人没有购买，也不打算购买任何左轮手枪，因此，居住在江西路35号的德国人 E.W.艾克霍夫（E.W. Eickhoff）最近关于组建联合体购买这些武器以防落入俄国人手中的说法不可能是真的。
艾克霍夫曾多次接触督军，试图向他出售约8000支步枪及弹药，他说如果督军支付要价，这些武器可以运到上海。
英国臣民 M.纽曼（M.Newman，现已回国）和居住在公平路1号的英国犹太人 E.H.希贝思（E.H.Shibbeth）也表现得好像他们受委托出售同样的步枪。
在此事中还提到了意大利人德尼格里（Denigri）和帕里亚尼（Pariani）、西班牙人 J.门卡里尼（J.Mencarini）、奥地利人 R.J.赫尔佐格（R.J.Herzog）以及圣皮耶罗·鲁金格（St. Piero Ruginger）的名字。
曾多次接触曾提督（Admiral Tseng），他假装感兴趣以确定步枪的真正所在地，但从未成功。他总是被告知武器的下落不明，但可以在两天内运抵上海。他最终放弃了，因为他开始怀疑武器卖家只是想从他那里骗钱，而没有其他目的。

As the result of enquiries made he ascertained
that , a former Governor of Szechom had, during the
regime of Chen Chi May陈其美 in Shanghai placed an
order for a somewhat similar number of rifles in
Germany, that these rifles had actually been shipped
from Germany but that there was no record to show
that they ever arrived in China and he imagined that
they might have been landed somewhere on the coast or
on islands near the entrance to the Yangtse although
it was hardly likely.
It was also suggested that the arms might have been
carried on to Japan and that they were stored at Nagasaki.
Anyhow nothing was discovered and these arms since
about the middle of the summer have ceased to be much
talked about. Recently however it appears that
efforts have been made by certain foreigners whose
names I do not know to sell a similar quantity of
rifles in Peking, the offers there being made under
similar conditions to those made to the Admiral.
Peking referred the matter to Shanghai and were
advised to have nothing to do with the business.
Now it looks as if the members of the same gang were
at present endeavouring to sell the arms to the Russians
and threatening that if they do not buy they will sell
to the Germans who are anxious to get them. They are
evidently quite prepared to accomodate the enemies of
their country and furnish them with weapons to shoot
their own brethren if there is to be any money to be
made out of it.
Enquiries are being made as to whether there are
any arms stored in Manila and we shall know in about a
fortnight from now. It is quite possible that a
consignment from Europe may have gone there for storage.
It is a convenient place.
The German mail steamer Bayern which was bound for
China when the war broke out sought shelter at Naples
and it is reported that when some months later Italy
declared war with Austria the vessel was searched and
a great quantity of rifles with ammunition consigned
to the Chinese Government was found on board and
confiscated. The local branch of the Chartered Bank
have knowledge of this affair , & I suggest that
enquiries should be made from them

作为调查结果，他查明，四川省前督军在陈其美在上海执政期间，曾在德国订购了数量大致相同的步枪，这些步枪确实已从德国装运，但没有记录显示它们曾抵达中国，他推测它们可能在沿海某处或长江口附近的岛屿上登陆，尽管这种可能性不大。
也有人提出，这些武器可能被运往日本，并储存在长崎。
无论如何，没有发现任何线索，自夏季中旬以来，这些武器已不再被广泛谈论。然而，最近似乎有一些我不知道名字的外国人试图在北京出售类似数量的步枪，那里的报价条件与向提督提出的条件相似。
北京方面将此事项转介至上海，并被告知不要参与此业务。
现在看起来，同一帮派的成员目前正试图将武器卖给俄国人，并威胁说如果俄国人不买，他们就卖给急于得到这些武器的德国人。他们显然完全准备迎合本国的敌人，并向他们提供武器以射击自己的同胞，只要从中能赚到钱。
我们正在调查马尼拉是否储存有任何武器，大约两周后我们将得知结果。很有可能有来自欧洲的货物运往那里储存。那是一个方便的地方。
战争爆发时正驶往中国的德国邮船“巴伐利亚”号（Bayern）在那不勒斯寻求庇护，据报道，几个月后意大利对奥地利宣战时，对该船进行了搜查，发现船上有一大批运往中国政府的步枪及弹药，并被没收。麦加利银行（Chartered Bank）当地分行知晓此事，我建议向他们进行查询。
